readerCopy.body: It can be easier to fight fiercely for someone else than to ask for the same protection for yourself. When Mars opposes Chiron, courage and vulnerability can split across a situation, making you decisive when another person is mistreated and strangely hesitant when the same issue affects you directly. That difference is useful information about where assertion still feels expensive. Take one action on your own behalf before all of your anger gets spent proving you know how to defend everyone except yourself.
